preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
The start vertex is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The vertices connected by an edge are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The weight of an edge is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The graph is connected, meaning there is a path between any two vertices.

preconditions.expression: no more than one edge between any pair of vertices
preconditions.description: There is at most one edge between any pair of vertices.

postconditions.expression: print the minimum total weight of the edges of the tree
postconditions.description: The output must include the minimum total weight of the edges in the shortest-path tree.

postconditions.expression: print the indices of the edges that are included in the tree
postconditions.description: The output must include the indices of the edges that form the shortest-path tree.
The indices of the edges must start from 1 and be in the order they appear in the input.

postconditions.expression: any valid tree can be printed
postconditions.description: The output can include any valid shortest-path tree for the given graph and start vertex.
